submitted.rationale: Of the three measured compositions, the Sb-rich end (Sb0.90Zn0.10) had the highest EQE at 2.4 eV (0.0015%). The ZnSb2O6 trirutile composition was about zero, and the Zn-rich end was about 4x lower. The GP model's predicted mean also rises toward the Sb-rich end, and index 29 is that end point.
